verdict.rationale: Fathom documents registrable outbound webhooks that POST meeting data (optionally summary, transcript, action items and CRM matches) to a URL of your choice. Webhooks can be created and deleted via the API or through the Manage > Add Webhook UI, payloads are signed, and the SDKs include a verify helper. Webhooks are included on all plans and appear in the changelog. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of event types beyond new meeting content (e.g., a broader event catalog or retry semantics).
